# The Tracker Guy

> Vehicle tracker installation in Nigeria, run by Fawas. Same day installation in Lagos. We fit GPS trackers on cars, bikes, keke, trucks, buses, boats and fleets, and we come to you.

## Facts
- Owner: Fawas, known as "the tracker guy". His family has fitted vehicle trackers since 2010 and has installed over 1,000 trackers.
- Based in Lagos, Nigeria.
- Same day installation in Lagos. In Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ogun State, Ibadan, Kaduna and Nasarawa, installation is same day or within up to 3 days.
- Contact: WhatsApp and phone +234 704 938 1183, email fawas@thetrackerguy.com.ng. Messages on WhatsApp are answered by Fawas himself between 7 a.m. and 10 p.m.
- Every vehicle is photographed before work starts, and the tracker is fitted in a hidden place. The customer sees the vehicle live on their phone before the installer leaves.

## Pricing
- Standard tracker: 100,000 naira. 20,000 naira yearly renewal after the first year (covers server hosting, app access and system maintenance).
- Advanced tracker: 125,000 naira. Includes audio monitoring (microphone). No yearly renewal fee. Has its own app with an optional subscription for extra features from 599 naira per month.
- SIM data is not included on either tracker. The customer pays for it.
- Fleet tracking is priced by quote. Message on WhatsApp.
